x.description: Array representing a time series of input values.

y.description: Array representing the second time series of input values, the same length as ``x`` along the specified ``axis``. If not specified, then assume ``y = x`` and compute the PSD ``Pxx`` of ``x`` via Welch's method.
constraints: y must be one of Pxx, PSD

window.description: Data tapering window to apply to each segment. Can be a window function name, a tuple specifying a window length and function, or an array (default: ``'hann'``).

noverlap.description: Number of points to overlap between segments (default: ``nperseg // 2``).

nfft.description: Length of the FFT used, if a zero-padded FFT is desired. If ``None`` (default), the FFT length is ``nperseg``.

detrend.description: Specifies how to detrend each segment. Can be ``False`` (default: no detrending), ``'constant'`` (remove mean), ``'linear'`` (remove linear trend), or a callable accepting a segment and returning a detrended segment.

return_onesided.description: If True (default), return a one-sided spectrum for real inputs. If False, return a two-sided spectrum.

scaling.description: Selects between computing the power spectral density (``'density'``, default) or the power spectrum (``'spectrum'``)

axis.description: Axis along which the CSD is computed (default: -1).

average.description: The type of averaging to use on the periodograms; one of ``'mean'`` (default) or ``'median'``.
constraints: average must be one of mean, median

output.description: A length-2 tuple of arrays ``(f, Pxy)``. ``f`` is the array of sample frequencies, and ``Pxy`` is the cross spectral density of `x` and `y`
